remarks: Location, location, location!! Move right into this immaculate 3 Bedroom Freshly painted Townhouse. Offering a large foyer, living room with fireplace and lots of windows, dining room with sliding doors to a good size deck! Newer kitchen with stainless steel appliances and granite counter tops, 2.5 updated bathrooms, Primary suite, and 2 good size rooms, All hardwood through out!! Full finished walk out basement, laundry area and access to a 1 car private garage! Walk to Glenbrook train station. Near shopping, parks, restaurants, downtown Stamford, bus stop and so much more. Priced to sell.
